question:
Who is the sixth Indian cricketer to be inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame?

[RRB NTPC ]
options: Sourav Ganguly
Rahul Dravid
Kapil Dev
Sachin Tendulkar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sachin Tendulkar

Explanation:
Sachin Tendulkar was inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame in 2019, becoming the sixth Indian cricketer to receive this honor. Before him, Bishan Singh Bedi, Sunil Gavaskar, Kapil Dev, Anil Kumble, and Rahul Dravid had been inducted. Tendulkar scored 100 international centuries and amassed over 34,000 runs, cementing his legacy as one of the greatest cricketers of all time. Induction into the ICC Hall of Fame is one of the highest honors in cricket.

Extra Facts:
The ICC Hall of Fame was established in 2009 to honor the greatest cricketers in history. Sir Don Bradman was the first inductee. Bishan Singh Bedi (2009) was the first Indian to be included. After Tendulkar's induction, players like Virat Kohli and MS Dhoni are also expected to be inducted in the future.

Important Points:
☛ Bishan Singh Bedi - First Indian (2009)
☛ Sunil Gavaskar - Second Indian (2012)
☛ Kapil Dev - 1983 World Cup-winning captain (2010)
☛ Anil Kumble - 600+ Test wickets (2015)
☛ Rahul Dravid - Nicknamed "The Wall" (2018)
☛ Sachin Tendulkar - 100 international centuries (2019)

सचिन तेंदुलकर

Explanation:
सचिन तेंदुलकर को 2019 में ICC क्रिकेट हॉल ऑफ फेम में शामिल किया गया था। वह इस सम्मान को पाने वाले छठे भारतीय क्रिकेटर हैं। उनसे पहले बिशन सिंह बेदी, सुनील गावस्कर, कपिल देव, अनिल कुंबले और राहुल द्रविड़ को यह सम्मान मिल चुका था। सचिन ने अपने करियर में 100 अंतरराष्ट्रीय शतक बनाए और 34,000 से अधिक रन बनाकर क्रिकेट के इतिहास में अमर हो गए। ICC हॉल ऑफ फेम में शामिल होना किसी भी क्रिकेटर के लिए सर्वोच्च सम्मानों में से एक है।

Extra Facts:
ICC हॉल ऑफ फेम की स्थापना 2009 में हुई थी, और इसमें दुनिया के सर्वश्रेष्ठ क्रिकेटर्स को शामिल किया जाता है। सर डॉन ब्रैडमैन पहले खिलाड़ी थे जिन्हें इस लिस्ट में जोड़ा गया। भारत के पहले खिलाड़ी बिशन सिंह बेदी (2009) थे। सचिन तेंदुलकर को यह सम्मान मिलने के बाद, विराट कोहली और एमएस धोनी जैसे खिलाड़ियों को भी भविष्य में शामिल किए जाने की उम्मीद है।

question:
How many Gold medals India won in the Olympics between 1928 and 1980?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: 7
5
6
8
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 8

Explanation:
Between 1928 and 1980, India won a total of 8 Gold medals in the Olympics. All these medals were won in Hockey. India clinched Gold in 1928 (Amsterdam), 1932 (Los Angeles), 1936 (Berlin), 1948 (London), 1952 (Helsinki), 1956 (Melbourne), 1964 (Tokyo), and 1980 (Moscow). During this period, the Indian Hockey team's performance was unparalleled, and they created a record by winning 6 consecutive Olympic Gold medals.

Extra Facts:
The Indian Hockey team is often referred to as the 'Golden Era', which lasted from 1928 to 1956. During this time, India won 6 Olympic Gold medals. Major Dhyan Chand is considered the cornerstone of this success and is famously known as the 'Wizard of Hockey'. The 1980 Gold medal was India's last Olympic Hockey Gold.

Important Points:
☛ 1928 Amsterdam Olympics - India's first Gold medal (Hockey)
☛ 1936 Berlin Olympics - Gold under Major Dhyan Chand's captaincy
☛ 1956 Melbourne Olympics - India's 6th Gold medal
☛ 1980 Moscow Olympics - India's last Hockey Gold
☛ 2008 Beijing Olympics - Abhinav Bindra (Gold in Shooting, Individual)

Extra Facts:

question:
Roger Federer is a famous player of __________ sport.

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Rugby
Lawn Bowls
Football
Lawn Tennis
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lawn Tennis

Explanation:
Roger Federer is a legendary player of Lawn Tennis. He is widely regarded as the 'Greatest of All Time (GOAT)' in tennis. Federer has won 20 Grand Slam titles and held the World No. 1 ranking for a record 310 weeks. His elegant playing style and sportsmanship have made him a global icon.

Extra Facts:
Federer has won Wimbledon 8 times and the US Open 5 times. He clinched a gold medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics. In 2018 Australian Open, he became the oldest Grand Slam champion at 36 years. Federer also holds the record for most consecutive weeks (237) as World No. 1.

question:
When was the pro kabaddi league inaugurated for the first time in India?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: 2007
2008
2015
2014
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2014

Explanation:
The Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) was inaugurated in 2014. It was jointly organized by Star Sports and Mashal Sports to promote kabaddi as a glamorous and professional sport. The first season was held from 26th July to 31st August 2014, featuring 8 teams. Jaipur Pink Panthers emerged as the champions of the inaugural season. PKL played a pivotal role in revolutionizing kabaddi's popularity in India.

Extra Facts:
PKL is the second most-watched Indian sports league after the IPL. Since its inception in 2014, it has expanded to 12 teams and attracted major sponsors like Patanjali and Vivo. The league has globalized kabaddi, with players from Iran, South Korea, and other nations participating. PKL's success inspired similar leagues worldwide.

It was a historic Olympics for India as Neeraj Chopra won the gold in javelin throw, bringing India its first-ever gold in track and field after 121 years. question:

Extra Facts:
The length of a tennis court is 78 feet, whether it's a singles or doubles match. The court has baselines and service lines on both ends, which define the rules of the game. The same dimensions apply in Grand Slam tournaments like Wimbledon, US Open, French Open, and Australian Open.

question:
In Kabaddi, a super tackle is when a raider is caught/self out/declared out with or less than how many defenders defending?

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: Six
Five
Three
Four
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Three

Explanation:
In Kabaddi, a super tackle occurs when a raider is caught or declared out by three or fewer defenders. In this scenario, the defending team earns 2 extra points, whereas a normal tackle awards only 1 point. This rule adds excitement to the game and allows teams to score big even with fewer defenders. The super tackle is a game-changer, especially during critical moments.

Extra Facts:
Kabaddi is an ancient Indian sport popularized globally by the Pro Kabaddi League (PKL). Each team has 7 players, and a match lasts 40 minutes (two halves of 20 minutes each). Apart from the super tackle, other key rules include the super raid (scoring 4+ points in a single raid) and all-out (entire team getting out). The sport emphasizes agility, strategy, and teamwork.

Important Points:
☛ Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) - Launched in 2014 (broadcast by Star Sports)
☛ Kabaddi World Cup - Started in 2004 (India won all editions)
☛ Ranjit Singh - Legendary kabaddi player (Arjuna Awardee)
☛ Padma Shri Anju Bobby George - Advocate for kabaddi promotion

question:
In hockey, what is the meaning of the signal if the umpire points both arms horizontally towards the goal?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Free hit
Penalty corner
Penalty stroke
Goal scored
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Penalty corner

Explanation:
In hockey, when the umpire raises both arms horizontally towards the goal, it signals a penalty corner. This is awarded when the defending team commits a serious foul inside the 'D' or intentionally hits the ball over the backline. A penalty corner is a crucial set-piece that gives the attacking team a strong opportunity to score.

Extra Facts:
A penalty corner is also known as a short corner. The ball is placed 10 yards from the backline, and attacking players push or hit the ball to attempt a goal. It is one of the most exciting aspects of hockey, with a high probability of scoring.

Important Points:
☛ Penalty stroke - Awarded when a defender (other than the goalkeeper) commits a foul on the goal line to prevent a goal.
☛ Free hit - Given for minor fouls; opponents must stay 5 meters away.
☛ Goal scored - When the ball completely crosses the goal line.
☛ Long corner - Used in older rules, now abolished.
☛ FIH - International Hockey Federation, which governs hockey rules worldwide.
question_hi:

Explanation:

question:
In which year was tennis included in the Olympic games?

भाला फेंक एक प्राचीन खेल है जिसकी उत्पत्ति यूनान में हुई थी। यह ओलंपिक खेलों का हिस्सा रहा है और इसमें एथलीट को भाले को अधिकतम दूरी तक फेंकना होता है। भारत में इस खेल को नीरज चोपड़ा की सफलता के बाद बहुत लोकप्रियता मिली है। अन्नू रानी एक अन्य प्रसिद्ध भारतीय भाला फेंक खिलाड़ी हैं, जिन्होंने अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर कई पदक जीते हैं।

Important Points:

question:
The Nehru Trophy competition near Alappuzha, held on the second Saturday of August every year, is the most competitive and popular of the _____category.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: badminto
basketball
boat races
horse races
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is boat races

Explanation:
The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is held annually on the second Saturday of August near Alappuzha, Kerala. It is one of the most prestigious and competitive boat race events in India, featuring traditional Kerala boats like Chundan Vallam (snake boats) and Vallam Kali. The race is deeply rooted in Kerala's culture and attracts massive crowds. It was named after India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, who inaugurated the event in 1952. The competition takes place on Punnamada Lake and is a major tourist attraction.

Extra Facts:
The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is the largest and most famous boat race in the world, with over 100 oarsmen rowing in synchronized motion. The event is organized by Kerala Tourism and is often referred to as 'Kerala's Onam Festival'. The race features beautifully decorated snake boats, and winning teams receive the prestigious Nehru Trophy. It symbolizes teamwork, tradition, and Kerala's rich maritime heritage.

Important Points:
☛ Vallam Kali – Traditional boat race of Kerala (features snake-shaped boats)
☛ Aranmula Vallamkali – Another famous boat race linked to Parthasarathy Temple
☛ Champakulam Moolam Boat Race – One of Kerala's oldest boat races
☛ Onam Festival – Kerala's grandest festival (includes boat races)
☛ Kerala Tourism – Famous for houseboats, backwaters, and boat races
question_hi:
हर वर्ष अगस्त के दूसरे शनिवार को, अलाप्पुझा (Alappuzha) के पास आयोजित की जाने वाली नेहरू ट्रॉफी प्रतियोगिता, ______श्रेणी में सबसे अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धी और लोकप्रिय है।

[SSC GD 2024]

बास्केटबॉल
नौका दौड़
घुड़दौड़
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है नौका दौड़

Explanation:
नेहरू ट्रॉफी प्रतियोगिता केरल के अलाप्पुझा में हर साल अगस्त के दूसरे शनिवार को आयोजित की जाती है। यह एक प्रसिद्ध नौका दौड़ (बोट रेस) प्रतियोगिता है, जिसमें केरल की पारंपरिक नौकाएँ जैसे चुंडन वल्लम और स्नेक बोट शामिल होती हैं। यह प्रतियोगिता केरल की संस्कृति और परंपरा का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है और इसमें बड़ी संख्या में दर्शक और प्रतिभागी शामिल होते हैं। इसका नाम भारत के पहले प्रधानमंत्री जवाहरलाल नेहरू के नाम पर रखा गया है, जिन्होंने 1952 में इस प्रतियोगिता की शुरुआत की थी।

Extra Facts:
नेहरू ट्रॉफी बोट रेस दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी और सबसे प्रतिष्ठित नौका दौड़ प्रतियोगिताओं में से एक है। इसमें 100 से अधिक नाविकों वाली विशाल नौकाएँ शामिल होती हैं, जो पंक्तिबद्ध होकर दौड़ती हैं। यह प्रतियोगिता पुन्नमदा झील पर आयोजित की जाती है और इसे 'केरल का ओणम उत्सव' भी कहा जाता है। इसका आयोजन केरल टूरिज्म द्वारा किया जाता है और यह राज्य के प्रमुख पर्यटन आकर्षणों में से एक है।

Important Points:

question:
What is the width of the court for double matches in Lawn Tennis?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: 38 feet
36 feet
34 feet
32 feet
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 36 feet

Explanation:
In Lawn Tennis, the width of the court for double matches is 36 feet. This is wider than the singles matches, where the court width is 27 feet. In doubles matches, an additional 4.5 feet is added on each side to provide more space for the players. This rule is set by the International Tennis Federation (ITF). The length of the court remains 78 feet for both singles and doubles matches.

Extra Facts:
Lawn Tennis court dimensions are highly precise. The width of a doubles court is 10.97 meters (36 feet), while a singles court is 8.23 meters (27 feet) wide. Tennis courts can have different surfaces, such as grass, clay, hard court, and carpet. Each surface has its own characteristics that influence the style of play.

Important Points:
☛ Tennis court length - 78 feet (for both singles and doubles)
☛ Court width for singles matches - 27 feet
☛ Grand Slam Tournaments - Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, US Open
☛ Wimbledon - Oldest tennis tournament (since 1877)
☛ Roger Federer - Most Grand Slam titles in men's tennis (20 titles)
question_hi:
लॉन टेनिस में जोड़ी में खेले जाने वाले मैचों (double matches) के लिए कोर्ट की चौड़ाई कितनी होती है ?

36 फीट

32 फीट
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 36 फीट

Explanation:
लॉन टेनिस में जोड़ी में खेले जाने वाले मैचों (डबल्स) के लिए कोर्ट की चौड़ाई 36 फीट होती है। यह सिंगल्स मैचों की तुलना में चौड़ा होता है, जिसमें कोर्ट की चौड़ाई 27 फीट होती है। डबल्स मैचों में प्रत्येक तरफ 4.5 फीट का अतिरिक्त स्थान जोड़ा जाता है, जिससे खिलाड़ियों को अधिक जगह मिलती है। यह नियम अंतर्राष्ट्रीय टेनिस महासंघ (ITF) द्वारा निर्धारित किया गया है। कोर्ट की लंबाई सिंगल्स और डबल्स दोनों में 78 फीट ही रहती है।

Extra Facts:
लॉन टेनिस कोर्ट के मापन में सटीकता बहुत महत्वपूर्ण होती है। डबल्स कोर्ट की चौड़ाई 10.97 मीटर (36 फीट) होती है, जबकि सिंगल्स कोर्ट की चौड़ाई 8.23 मीटर (27 फीट) होती है। टेनिस कोर्ट की सतह विभिन्न प्रकार की हो सकती है, जैसे ग्रास (घास), क्ले (मिट्टी), हार्ड कोर्ट (कठोर), और कार्पेट (गलीचा)। प्रत्येक सतह की अपनी विशेषताएं होती हैं, जो खेल के तरीके को प्रभावित करती हैं।

Important Points:
☛ टेनिस कोर्ट की लंबाई - 78 फीट (सिंगल्स और डबल्स दोनों)

question:
The shape of a basketball court is a _____________

[SSC CPO 2023]
options: circle
rectangle
square
triangle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is rectangle

Explanation:
The shape of a basketball court is rectangular. The court is 28 meters long and 15 meters wide, as standardized by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA). It has a basket at each end, mounted at a height of 3.05 meters. The court is divided into two equal halves by a midcourt line and features important markings such as the free-throw line, three-point line, and key area.

Extra Facts:
Basketball was invented in 1891 by Dr. James Naismith. The first game was played at Springfield College, Massachusetts. The NBA (National Basketball Association) is the most famous basketball league globally, founded in 1946. Basketball has been part of the Olympics since 1936.

Important Points:
☛ NBA - Most famous basketball league (founded in 1946)
☛ FIBA - International Basketball Federation (founded in 1932)
☛ Basketball in Olympics - Included since 1936 (first gold won by the USA)
☛ Basketball World Cup - First held in 1950 (won by Argentina)
☛ WNBA - Women's basketball league (founded in 1996)
question_hi:

बास्केटबॉल कोर्ट की आकृति आयताकार होती है। यह कोर्ट 28 मीटर लंबा और 15 मीटर चौड़ा होता है, जिसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय बास्केटबॉल महासंघ (FIBA) द्वारा निर्धारित किया गया है। कोर्ट के दोनों छोर पर एक-एक बास्केट लगा होता है, जिसकी ऊँचाई 3.05 मीटर होती है। कोर्ट को मध्य रेखा द्वारा दो बराबर भागों में बाँटा जाता है, और इसमें फ्री-थ्रो लाइन, थ्री-पॉइंट लाइन, और की-एरिया जैसे महत्वपूर्ण चिह्न होते हैं।

बास्केटबॉल की खोज 1891 में डॉ. जेम्स नाइस्मिथ ने की थी। यह खेल पहली बार स्प्रिंगफील्ड कॉलेज, मैसाचुसेट्स में खेला गया था। NBA (नेशनल बास्केटबॉल एसोसिएशन) दुनिया का सबसे प्रसिद्ध बास्केटबॉल लीग है, जिसकी स्थापना 1946 में हुई थी। बास्केटबॉल ओलंपिक में 1936 से शामिल है।

question:
Who among the following became the third Cricketer to hit six sixes in an over in International Cricket?

[RRB NTPC ]
options: Kieron Pollard
Yuvraj Singh
Virendra Sehwag
Herschelle Gibbs
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Herschelle Gibbs

Explanation:
Herschelle Gibbs became the third cricketer to hit six sixes in an over in international cricket. He achieved this feat on 16 March 2007 during the 2007 World Cup against Netherlands bowler Daan van Bunge. Before him, this record was achieved by Gary Sobers (1968) and Ravi Shastri (1985). Gibbs accomplished this in ODI cricket, while Yuvraj Singh later achieved it in T20 World Cup 2007.

Extra Facts:
Herschelle Gibbs was a prominent South African batsman who played 90 Tests and 248 ODIs. He was known for his aggressive batting and holds the distinction of being the first batsman to hit six sixes in a World Cup match. He scored 21 centuries and 112 fifties in his career.

Important Points:
☛ Gary Sobers - First player to hit six sixes in an over (1968, County Cricket)
☛ Ravi Shastri - Second player to achieve this feat (1985, Ranji Trophy)
☛ Yuvraj Singh - First player to hit six sixes in T20 cricket (2007, T20 World Cup)
☛ Kieron Pollard - West Indies all-rounder, but he has not achieved this record

हर्शल गिब्स

question:
Heptathlon for women includes ______ events.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: 11
7
5
10
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 7

Explanation:
The Heptathlon is a multi-event competition for women that includes 7 different track and field events. The competition is held over two days, where athletes compete in various events and are awarded points based on their performance. The events include the 100m hurdles, high jump, shot put, 200m sprint, long jump, javelin throw, and 800m run. It is similar to the men's Decathlon (10 events), but the number of events is fewer for women.

Extra Facts:
The Heptathlon is part of the Olympic Games and was introduced in the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics. Athletes must perform well in all events, as a weak performance in one event can affect the overall score. Jackie Joyner-Kersee is considered the most successful heptathlete, having set a world record at the 1988 Seoul Olympics.

महिलाओं के लिए हेप्टाथलॉन (Heptathlon) में ______स्पर्धा शामिल होती हैं।

7

हेप्टाथलॉन महिलाओं के लिए एक बहु-खेल प्रतियोगिता है जिसमें 7 विभिन्न ट्रैक और फील्ड स्पर्धाएँ शामिल होती हैं। यह प्रतियोगिता दो दिनों में आयोजित की जाती है, जहाँ एथलीटों को विभिन्न स्पर्धाओं में प्रदर्शन करना होता है और उनके प्रदर्शन के आधार पर अंक दिए जाते हैं। इसमें 100 मीटर बाधा दौड़, उच्च कूद, शॉट पुट, 200 मीटर दौड़, लंबी कूद, भाला फेंक और 800 मीटर दौड़ शामिल हैं। यह पुरुषों के डेकाथलॉन (10 स्पर्धाएँ) के समान है, लेकिन महिलाओं के लिए स्पर्धाओं की संख्या कम होती है।

question:
In which year was the Department of Sports transformed into the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports ?

[SSC CPO 2024]
options: 1983
1982
1985
1984
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1982

Explanation:
The Department of Sports was transformed into the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports in 1982. This change was made by the Government of India to adopt an integrated approach towards youth development and sports promotion. Earlier, the Sports Department functioned separately, but in 1982, it was merged with Youth Affairs to focus on the holistic development of the country's youth. This year is also associated with the hosting of the Asian Games (1982, New Delhi), which boosted India's sports culture.

Extra Facts:
The year 1982 was a turning point in Indian sports history. The Asian Games were held in New Delhi the same year, where India won 13 gold medals. This event accelerated the development of sports infrastructure in India and inspired youth to pursue careers in sports. The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports remains responsible for implementing sports policies and youth programs in the country.

question_hi:
किस वर्ष खेल विभाग को युवा मामले एवं खेल विभाग में परिवर्तित किया गया था ?

Explanation:
खेल विभाग को युवा मामले एवं खेल विभाग में 1982 में परिवर्तित किया गया था। यह परिवर्तन भारत सरकार द्वारा युवाओं के विकास और खेलों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए एकीकृत दृष्टिकोण अपनाने के उद्देश्य से किया गया था। इससे पहले, खेल विभाग अलग से कार्य करता था, लेकिन 1982 में इसे युवा मामलों के साथ जोड़ दिया गया ताकि देश के युवाओं के समग्र विकास पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया जा सके। इस वर्ष को एशियाई खेलों के आयोजन (1982, नई दिल्ली) के साथ भी जोड़ा जाता है, जिसने भारत में खेल संस्कृति को बढ़ावा दिया।

Extra Facts:
1982 का वर्ष भारतीय खेल इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ था। इसी वर्ष नई दिल्ली में एशियाई खेलों का आयोजन किया गया, जिसमें भारत ने 13 स्वर्ण पदक जीते। इस आयोजन ने भारत में खेल अवसंरचना के विकास को गति दी और युवाओं को खेलों में करियर बनाने के लिए प्रेरित किया। युवा मामले एवं खेल मंत्रालय आज भी देश में खेल नीतियों और युवा कार्यक्रमों को लागू करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

question:
In football, a kick is awarded to the opposition player when a player has committed a foul. What is the kick called?

[SSC CPO 2023]
options: Bicycle kick
Goal kick
Wide kick
Free kick
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Free kick

Explanation:
A free kick in football is awarded to the opposing team when a player commits a foul. It is taken from the spot where the foul occurred and can be directly scored into the goal. Free kicks are of two types: direct free kick (which can be scored directly) and indirect free kick (where the ball must touch another player before a goal can be scored). This rule ensures fair play and penalizes fouls effectively.

Extra Facts:
In football, apart from free kicks, there are other types of kicks like penalty kick (awarded for fouls inside the penalty box) and corner kick (when the ball crosses the goal line after touching a defending player). Free kicks can be game-changers, as skilled players often score directly from them, making them a crucial part of set-piece strategies.

Important Points:
☛ Penalty kick - Awarded for fouls inside the penalty box (taken from 12 yards)
☛ Corner kick - Awarded when the ball crosses the goal line after touching a defending player
☛ Goal kick - Awarded when the ball crosses the goal line after touching an attacking player
☛ Throw-in - Awarded when the ball crosses the sideline
☛ Drop ball - Used by the referee to restart the game after a stoppage

question:
In table tennis, what is the maximum number of consecutive lets permitted during a serve?

[SSC GD 2025]
options: One
Two
Three
No limit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is [No limit]

Explanation:
In table tennis, there is no maximum limit on the number of consecutive lets permitted during a serve. If the ball touches the net during service but otherwise complies with all the rules, it is called a let, and the server must serve again. This process can be repeated until the serve is correctly executed. According to the ITTF (International Table Tennis Federation) rules, there is no restriction on the number of lets.

Extra Facts:
In table tennis, a let occurs when the ball touches the net during service but the serve is otherwise valid. If the ball goes into the opponent's court after touching the net, the serve is replayed. The ITTF has recently made some rule changes, but the rule regarding lets remains unchanged.
